(If frozen, how long has it been thawing?) - **Brining?** (e.g., "Soak in salt water overnight" or " dry-brine with spices") - **Stuffing?** (Inside the cavity? In a separate dish? Dry-brine with ¼ cup salt + tbsp pepper on skin overnight. Stuff with cornbread dressing (recipe below). Roast at 325°F for 13 mins per pound. Baste every 45 mins with pan juices. Remove foil when golden. Rest 45 mins.
